mapper.select:
SELECT *, ROUND(PRICE) AS CONVERT_PRICE FROM PRODUCT WHERE 1=1 and status = 'SALE'
AND CATEGORY = #{category}
ORDER BY PRICE ASC
ORDER BY PRICE DESC
ORDER BY RELEASE_DATE DESC
ORDER BY PRODUCT_ID ASC
mapper.delete: UPDATE PRODUCT SET STATUS ='STOP' WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT(CATEGORY, PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, DESCRIPTION) VALUES(#{category}, NULL, #{productName}, #{description})
mapper.select: SELECT P.PRODUCT_NAME, SUM(O.ORDER_PRICE) AS TOTAL_PRICE FROM PRODUCT_ORDERS O INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON O.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_NAME
